description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to user session management, including operations like listing authorized tenants, setting the active tenant, and toggling global tenant access for super admins. It incorporates authentication, authorization, audit logging, and response handling for tenant-related endpoints.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Handles retrieving a list of tenants the current user is authorized to access, performs audit logging, and responds with the tenant list.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant for the current session after validating user access; updates cookies and performs audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias route that reuses the /tenant route handler to select an active tenant.

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Allows super admins to toggle a global mode that disables tenant filtering for the session, with audit logging and response headers indicating the state.
